title: Grateful Dead Live at Carter-Finley Stadium on 1990-07-10
source: Master Audience Recorded By Steve Hill, Transfer By Keo; 2 Nakamichi CM100/CP4 Shotguns + 1 Sennheiser 421 > Unknown Mixer (Either A Radio Shack Or Boss) 1/4 Inch In/RCA Out > Sony TC-D5m, Tapes:Maxell MX 90 + 100; Transfer With Nakamichi MR-1 > Korg MR-1000 @ 1 Bit/5.6 MHz; Tracking/Sample Rate Conversion/Flacked With AudioGate Software To 24/96 kHz; Metadata Tagging With Tag&Rename

ai_review.summary: Audience recording captures a storm‑hit show where the Dead power through a blackout with an inspiring jam.
ai_review.review: The reviewer describes a thrilling first‑time experience, noting how a sudden stadium-wide power outage was met with the band diving straight back into their improvisations. The recording picks up crowd ambience and even the lightning’s crackle, giving listeners a vivid sense of the night despite any technical imperfections.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one enthusiastic 5‑star review; show quality is clearly excellent while recording details are sparse, leading to a strong but uncertain overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Captures crowd noise, lightning and the moment of power loss; no specific complaints about clarity, suggesting a listenable though ambient‑rich tape.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Unique event – a storm caused a brief blackout, after which the band launched straight into an extended jam, keeping momentum high throughout the set.
